# migadu Provider



## Example Usage

```terraform
provider "migadu" {
  username = "user@example.com"
  api_key  = "your-api-key"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) Migadu API key.
- `username` (String) Migadu username (email address used to log in).
